Class UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController

public without sharing class UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController

Apex controller for flow Upsert Payment Adjustments. Creates/edits adjustments with refunds in Firestore database for the given payment. This controller manages the synchronization of payment refund data between Salesforce and the Firestore backend database.

private static Object defineRefundJsonFields(BlazeBitePayments.RefundValues refund)

Converts BlazeBitePayments.RefundValues data into Firestore-compatible JSON format. Overloaded method used when processing existing refunds from Firestore.

Parameters:
    refund – BlazeBitePayments.RefundValues object containing existing refund data

Returns:
    Object JSON-compatible object ready for Firestore storage

private static Object defineRefundJsonFields(UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController.RefundInformation refund)

Converts RefundInformation data into Firestore-compatible JSON format. Uses the builder pattern with the Refund inner class to construct the JSON structure.

Parameters:
    refund – RefundInformation object containing the refund details to convert

Returns:
    Object JSON-compatible object ready for Firestore storage

@InvocableMethod(category='BlazeBite' description='Given a payment, creates a new refund or allows to modified an existing one' label='Upsert Payment Refund' callout=true)
public static List<UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController.RefundResult> upsertRefundInFirestore(List<UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController.RefundInformation> refundInfo)

Flow-accessible method to upsert a payment refund in Firestore. Acts as a wrapper for the main upsert method, accepting a list for Flow compatibility.

Parameters:
    refundInfo – List containing a single RefundInformation object with the refund details

Returns:
    List List containing a single RefundResult with the operation outcome

public static UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController.RefundResult upsertRefundInFirestore(UpsertPaymentRefundFlowController.RefundInformation refundInfo)

Core method that performs the upsert operation for a payment refund in Firestore. Retrieves the payment from Firestore, manages existing refunds, and either creates a new refund or updates an existing one based on the provided information.

Parameters:
    refundInfo – RefundInformation object containing the details of the refund to upsert

Returns:
    RefundResult Object containing the operation outcome including success status and refund details
